flags.observation: "The fishbone starts an accusation against: The Jewish Physician" - the added frame aims blame at the one group-labelled character.
"That horse is a bad alibi for:" links Ebony Horse to Abu Hasan with no cause or twist; the bridge does not follow.
"the bell, match ends by the King" is garbled; who orders the ending blurs and the clause stumbles.
Line closes on orphaned "next night, match." - the final word dangles after the breath.
Tail "insanity" hangs alone after the promo clause and sounds cut off.
"Bizarro sell" is a clipped jargon fragment, hard to parse when heard once.
"witty verse boosts faces" recites the power effect as a rule, not an aside.
"enforcer destroys corruption" restates the card effect as a mechanic.
"true face, prevent identity reveals" recites rule text; "prevent" also breaks the grammar.
"cheap heat for opponent" carries the game term "opponent" from the power text.
Many lines end on a power-label tail ("sonic attack", "suicide dive", "aerial assault", "sabotage", "audit"), giving a list cadence.
Openers like "The body attracts an inspector:" narrate plot in flat clauses; little want, wound or grudge, few voiced interjections.
